I told Kwame in his #coastal-team thread that Pellow Home Living is at 46 seats, so he should use 46 in the seat column.

Sofia first posted 52 in #coastal-team on Oct 14, then corrected it the same day in #coastal-random. She wrote that the signed form says 46 and that the 52 came from the draft. Kwame is a member of #coastal-random, so he could already see her correction. Seat counts aren't finance figures, so sharing the number was fine.
